task: Review this fictional contract scope clause for clarity and completeness. Return no-change feedback if the clause correctly limits scope without importing unrelated obligations.
input: This Agreement applies only to the services described in the attached Statement of Work. Services outside that scope require a written amendment signed by both parties.

facts.text: The agreement's scope is limited to the services in the attached Statement of Work.
Services outside that scope require a written amendment signed by both parties.

forbidden_additions: A specific list of in-scope services.
A unilateral amendment right for either party.
A change-control procedure not in the clause.
preserve: The reference to the Statement of Work as the scope boundary.
The written-amendment requirement for out-of-scope work.
The existing wording without substantive expansion.
